plot_events_dataframe: plot events from a pandas DataFrame as square waves with color-coded event kinds and word labels
plot_events_custom_window: plot events with a custom time window size to control x-axis duration per row
plot_events_no_description: plot events without displaying word descriptions by setting show_desc to False
plot_events_custom_axes: plot events into an existing matplotlib axes object for multi-panel figure layouts
review_EVENT_COLOR_AND_HEIGHT: review the EVENT_COLOR_AND_HEIGHT dictionary that maps event kinds to their color and height values
